articles.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
articles.snippet: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

articles.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
articles.snippet: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say
articles.snippet: Technical indicators suggest the bullish trend remains intact, but prediction market traders are sending mix signals.

articles.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
articles.snippet: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
articles.snippet: The scammers also ran a fake recovery service, contacting victims weeks later with promises to get their stolen crypto back.
